{{Quote|Fresh Sizhranian lettuce tossed with Hocekureem Sea salt croutons. Fit for a Falleen prince!|The menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="dad" />}}
'''Sizhranian lettuce''' was a type of [[Lettuce/Legends|lettuce]] included in [[Xizor salad]]. The [[Salad/Legends|salad]] was served tossed with [[Hocekureem Sea salt crouton]]s at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="dad" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] owner of the diner, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], described the lettuce as fresh in his menu.<ref name="dad" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sizhranian lettuce was introduced in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="dad" />
